text: Control Science and Engineering is an engineering discipline centered on "system control". It studies how to design algorithms and construct systems to ensure that various objects such as machinery, electronics, and information operate stably according to the expected goals, and even achieve autonomous optimization. From the automation of industrial production lines to the precise flight of unmanned aircraft, from the coordinated control of smart homes to the attitude adjustment of spacecraft, all of these rely on the theoretical and technical support of control science and engineering.
